card.architecture: Anima 2B anime base (Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE) as the img2img denoiser under per-step PixelManifoldProjection + final PixelQuantize
card.summary: Pixel art with ANIMA authoring under reprojection: the per-step pixel-manifold projection clamps the x0 estimate onto a fixed grid+palette every denoise step while Anima (the house-style anime model) supplies the structure. Unlike Flux/Qwen pixelizers, Anima is an authoring model, so reference=0 (full denoise) lets it draw the scene from the prompt with the grid constraint live. style_prompt blank -> the caller's instruction is the prompt. API-only.
use_cases: test whether Anima holds a projection/composition under per-step reprojection
house-style pixel-art environments authored under the pixel-manifold constraint
card.pick_when: You want Anima to author pixel art directly, with the pixel grid+palette enforced during generation.
